name: PIN Unlock
description: Submits the login and lock screen password once it reaches a fixed length, the way a Windows Hello PIN does, so a PIN of the configured length logs in without pressing Enter. The length is read from the 'pin-length' file in this directory, which system/87-login-pin.sh writes from loginPinLength in user-config.nix; with that file absent or unusable the extension does nothing at all.
